identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts or @fontsource in index.css

card.base: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 rounded-xl shadow-none overflow-hidden hover:border-white/10 transition-colors duration-300

button.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(99,102,241,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
button.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
button.ghost: text-muted-foreground hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors rounded-lg px-4 py-2

input.base: bg-[#050505] border border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 transition-all duration-200

badge.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

layout_strategies.feed: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 auto-rows-fr

universal_guidelines: Always start with Dark Mode as default.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data, IDs, and code snippets.
Avoid solid pure white backgrounds; use off-white or light gray if light mode is absolutely necessary.
Pain points should be visualized with color-coded intensity (Red=Severe, Yellow=Moderate).
Opportunity Score must use a radial gauge or progress ring visualization.
Business Briefs should look like official documents: clean, structured, monospace headers.
Landing Page Copy generator should feature a 'Typewriter' effect for the output.
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute.
Do not use gradients for text unless it's the main H1 title.
Ensure all forms have proper validation states (error red border + text).
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the 'Bloomberg Terminal for Indie Hackers'. Stick to the Dark Theme strictly. Use the provided asset URLs for backgrounds. Implement the Bento Grid for the Idea Feed. Use 'Lucide-React' for icons. Prioritize density and information hierarchy over whitespace in the dashboard, but use generous whitespace in the Landing Page.
